# @local/dsh-sidebar-browser-control
Host + Client plugin that gives the agent a real browser in the DSH sidebar.

- **Host half** (`index.js`): registers the `browser` tool and a loopback bridge
(`bridge.js`, bound

to 127.0.0.1) that carries tool actions to the renderer.
The bridge requires `Authorization: Bearer

<token>` (never a query parameter),
rejects a foreign `Host` header, and only admits the DSH render

er origin
(`dsh-app://app` / `null`) so a random web page cannot drive it.
- **Preview server** (`li

b/preview.js`): read-only static server for local QA
(see Local preview).
- **Client half** (`client

.js`): registers the `Agent Browser` sidebar tab type,
owns a leased Electron `<webview>` (through `

window.dshDesktop.browser`),
executes actions with `executeJavaScript` (snapshot/refs, page measurem

ent,
theme shim) and `sendInputEvent` (trusted clicks/typing/scroll), and injects a
shadow-DOM virtu

al cursor so the user can watch the agent without the OS
pointer moving.
## Tool surface

`browser(action)` — every action returns `{ text }`; coordinates are CSS pixels
inside the page view

ser(action)` — every action returns `{ text }`; coordinates are CSS pixels
inside the page viewport.
### Interaction
| action | arguments | meaning |
| `open` | `url` | show the sidebar panel and navigate (also reopens after `close`); recovers once f
rom a stale never-ready panel by remounting; a failed load returns `{ok:false, error, attemptedUrl,
loadFailure}` with a normalized guest error (e.g. `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (-102) loading '<url>'`) i
nstead of Electron's raw IPC wrapper, and a navigation that lands on Chromium's error page returns `

ok:true, loaded:false` with the warning instead of a bare `opened` |
| `navigate` | `url` | navigate

the panel, opening it first when it is closed; same structured failure receipt as `open` |
| `snaps

hot` | – | title/url/viewport + interactive elements with refs |
| `click` | `ref` or `x,y` | move t

he virtual cursor, hit-test, dispatch real mouse input |
| `type` | `text`, optional `ref` | focus t

he ref (optional) and type |
| `key` | `key` | Enter/Tab/Escape/Arrow* |
| `scroll` | `deltaY`, opti
onal `ref` | wheel input + script fallback; receipt has `requested/actualDelta/scrollY/scrollHeight/

innerHeight/clamped/method` |
| `scrollIntoView` | `ref` or `selector`, `block` | scroll a target in

to view and report the resulting position |
| `wait` | `ms` / `selector` / `text` / `networkIdle`+`i

dleMs` / `images` / `fonts` | in-page polling; `ms` is the timeout when conditions are given |
| `st
atus` | – | bridge state merged with the panel's viewport/theme/console counters/last url + the last
`attemptedUrl`, the DSH Host `hostOrigin` (desktop only; lets an agent predict the shell isolation
before hitting it), the freshness pair `lastLoadedAt`/`contentSource` (`navigation` or `setContent`;
says whether `lastUrl`/`lastTitle` describe the same document) and `lastLoadFailure` (`errorCode`/`
errorDescription`/`validatedURL`/`isMainFrame`/`at`) as the last observed failure, plus `lastLoadFai
lureStale` when a later successful load makes that failure stale (the raw failure is kept as the dia
when a later successful load makes that failure stale (the raw failure is kept as the diagnostic) |
### QA and evidence
| action | arguments | meaning |
| `viewport` | `width`, `height` (default 800), `reset`, `scrollbars` (`auto` default / `hidden`) |
set the real guest CSS viewport (the panel scales to fit); `scrollbars:"hidden"` persistently hides
the page scrollbars (content width == viewport width; replayed after navigation, removed by `reset`/
`close`); receipt reports actual `innerWidth/innerHeight/devicePixelRatio/contentWidth` and explains

the classic-scrollbar difference |
| `evaluate` | `expression` | `executeJavaScript` wrapper; JSON

result, Host receipt capped at 16KB |
| `metrics` | `selectors[]`, `includeOverflow` | viewport/docu
ment sizes, content width, top-20 horizontal overflow, images (total/loaded/failed + src), `document

.fonts.status`, console error/warning counts, per-selector rect/natural size |
| `logs` | `clear`, `

filter`, `limit` | console-message ring buffer (≤200) + page-side failed-image/resource probe |
| `s
creenshot` | `fullPage`, `clip{x,y,width,height}`, `ref`, `selector`, `format` (`png`/`jpeg`), `qual
ity`, `path`, `hideCursor` | saves PNG/JPEG evidence and reports the real pixel size parsed from the
file; `fullPage` scroll-stitches viewport captures (≤12000 CSS px; fixed/sticky elements may repeat
) and reports stage diagnostics, per-step `timings` and the segment count; an element taller than th
e viewport (or outside it) is scroll-stitched instead of clipped (≤12000, `capped`/`croppedWidth` an
notated); every stitch step has a timeout; fullPage rides a longer bridge command timeout (default 1

20s, `DSH_BROWSER_CONTROL_FULLPAGE_TIMEOUT_MS`) |
| `emulate` | `colorScheme` (`light`/`dark`/`auto`
) | best-effort light/dark preference: matchMedia shim, same-origin `@media (prefers-color-scheme)`
rewrite, plus a DOM fallback that re-picks native `<picture><source media>` and normalizes `<link re
l=stylesheet media>` (including open shadow roots, capped at 6000 nodes); counters in the receipt; f

ully restored by `auto`; replayed on navigation (open/navigate/click/key) |
